in_sanskrit.name: सुमेध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'sum' meaning 'good, excellent, or well' and 'medh' meaning 'intellect, wisdom, or intelligence'.

in_hindi.name: Sumedh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious over thought
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sumedh एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sumedh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word sum meaning 'good' and dh meaning 'thought'. This name signifies being victorious over one's own thoughts, implying a strong and focused mind.

in_tamil.name: Sumedh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Victorious over thought
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sumedh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Sumedh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word sum meaning 'good' and dh meaning 'thought'. This name signifies being victorious over one's own thoughts, implying a strong and focused mind.

in_telugu.name: Sumedh
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Victorious over thought

This name signifies being victorious over one's own thoughts, implying a strong and focused mind.

in_marathi.name: Sumedh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious over thought
